labels.text: Dictate into the composer without sending

S49.01.needs: a microphone, and a transcription route (a signed-in account, OPENAI_API_KEY, or the whisper program on PATH)
S49.01.note: There is no microphone button; the control is the /dictate command. The Expected line's 'microphone control' is a typed command. Managed transcription may also be refused by a plan capability check, which I did not trace.
steps: Start agi and wait for the message box.
Type /dictate and press Enter.
Press SPACE, say a short sentence, then press ENTER to stop.
Look at the message box: the spoken words should appear there as text.
S49.01.where: agi, then type /dictate in the message box

labels.text: dictation added to the composer, Enter to send

S49.02.needs: a microphone, and a transcription route (a signed-in account, OPENAI_API_KEY, or the whisper program on PATH)
S49.02.note: In /dictate the transcript goes straight into the message box with no separate confirm step; the confirm-and-edit step exists only in /voice (apps/cli/src/voice.rs).
steps: Type /dictate, press Enter, then SPACE, say a sentence, and press ENTER.
Read the notice that appears after the text is added.
Move the cursor with the left arrow key and change a word in the message box.
Press Enter to send and check the sent message contains your edit, not the raw transcript.
S49.02.where: agi, then type /dictate in the message box

labels.text: Voice mode language hint (ISO 639-1 code, default: en).

S49.03.needs: a microphone, and a transcription route (a signed-in account, OPENAI_API_KEY, or the whisper program on PATH)
S49.03.note: The chosen language is not shown on the /dictate screen; /voice does show 'Language:'. The 20 codes are in apps/cli/src/voice_languages.rs.
steps: Start agi with agi --voice-lang fr (or another code such as es or de).
Type /dictate and press Enter, then SPACE, speak in that language, and press ENTER.
Check the transcript comes back in that language in the message box.
Type /dictate xx with an unsupported code and check the error 'Dictation failed:' appears before any recording.
S49.03.where: agi --voice-lang <code> at startup, or type /dictate <code> in the message box

labels.text: dictation added to the composer, Enter to send

S49.05.needs: a microphone, and a transcription route (a signed-in account, OPENAI_API_KEY, or the whisper program on PATH)
S49.05.note: If transcription fails the screen shows 'Transcription failed:' instead of the text.
steps: Type /dictate and press Enter.
Press SPACE, say a sentence, then press ENTER.
Wait for the spinner 'Transcribing...' to finish.
Check the final text is in the message box and the notice 'dictation added to the composer, Enter to send' appears.
S49.05.where: agi, then type /dictate in the message box

labels.text: [R to retry this recording, any other key to drop it]

S49.06.needs: a microphone, and a way to make transcription fail such as no network
steps: Type /dictate, press Enter, then SPACE, say something, and press ENTER.
Make transcription fail, for example by turning off the network.
When 'Transcription failed:' appears, press R.
Check the same recording is transcribed again and the text appears without recording again.
S49.06.where: agi, then type /dictate in the message box

S49.07.needs: a microphone, and a transcription route (a signed-in account, OPENAI_API_KEY, or the whisper program on PATH)
S49.07.note: After a recording is transcribed, /dictate has no discard step; the 'ESC to discard' choice exists only in /voice (apps/cli/src/voice.rs).
steps: Type /dictate and press Enter, then press SPACE, say a few words, and press ESC before pressing ENTER.
Check the notice 'dictation cancelled' appears.
Check the message box is still empty, so nothing was inserted.
Optionally, press ESC right after /dictate before SPACE to see the same notice.
S49.07.where: agi, then type /dictate in the message box

S49.09.needs: a microphone, and a transcription route (a signed-in account, OPENAI_API_KEY, or the whisper program on PATH)
S49.09.note: The code sends each whole recording as one upload (transcribe_managed and transcribe_openai_api in apps/cli/src/voice.rs), and recording stops at 120 seconds. No batch control is shown to the user.
steps: Type /dictate, press Enter, then SPACE, speak for 10 to 20 seconds, and press ENTER.
Watch the spinner 'Transcribing...' while it waits.
Check the full text appears in one piece, with no partial words during the wait.
S49.09.where: after /dictate, SPACE and ENTER: the whole text appears at once after 'Transcribing...'

S49.17.needs: a microphone, and a transcription route (a signed-in account, OPENAI_API_KEY, or the whisper program on PATH)
S49.17.note: The notice is remembered per destination in a marker file, so it shows only once unless the config folder is fresh.
steps: Type /dictate and press Enter.
Read the notice that says the microphone records only after SPACE and that each recording is sent to a named destination.
Press ESC instead of ENTER and check 'dictation cancelled' appears with nothing recorded.
Run /dictate again and press ENTER to agree, then check that SPACE starts recording.
S49.17.where: agi, then type /dictate in the message box (first use only)

labels.text: (release SPACE or press ENTER to stop)

S49.19.needs: a microphone, and a transcription route (a signed-in account, OPENAI_API_KEY, or the whisper program on PATH)
S49.19.note: The prompt says release SPACE, but many terminals do not report key release, so ENTER is the stop. Recording also stops by itself at 120 seconds.
steps: Type /dictate, press Enter, then press SPACE.
Watch the line that starts with REC: the seconds count up.
Speak for about 5 seconds, then press ENTER to stop.
Check the count stopped near the time you spoke and the line is gone or replaced.
S49.19.where: agi, then type /dictate in the message box
